Ox Alpha finally has a face. It is GLM 5.3 Flash, a 320B text model at $0.50 per million output tokens ($0.25 on OpenRouter right now). I ran it through my harder bench: Halo clone, XCOM-like, TARDIS phone case, sales page, Diablo isometric, Fifth Avenue drone, penguin SVG, messy Q3 close. It tied for 4th with a 91. Because it is the cheapest, it ranks higher. That is the price-to-performance story.

CORRECTION:  GLM 5.3 Flash IS Multimodal! (I said it wasn't like a moron in the video :) )
